name: lv_obj_clear_flag

provenance.source: Veneer (LDR.W PC,[PC]) into the version-stable LVGL library entry 0x1C028C85; the veneer target is identical in 3.101.036 and 3.101.043. The msgbox constructor and the stock list-class constructors call it with flag masks 2 (CLICKABLE), 8 and 16 (SCROLLABLE) in the position where Band 11 calls its lv_obj_clear_flag (FW_LV_OBJECT_CLEAR_FLAG). Second argument is the LV_OBJ_FLAG mask (HIDDEN = 1).

notes: Target-private UI host use only (hide/show, scroll lock). Device probe pending.
